salut.consejo: The final t is not pronounced. The French u is said to be putting the lips of «u» and saying «i».

je.consejo: The French «j» sounds like a «sh» with a voice.

enchantée.consejo: It sounds just like the masculine; it only changes when you write.

parents.consejo: As in English: parents, not relatives.

fils.consejo: Here the s is pronounced and the l is not.

œufs.consejo: In singular, «un œuf», the f is pronounced; in plural, «œufs» is pronounced without the f or s final. In «les œufs» you can hear a link z between the two words.

ou.consejo: No accent is «or»; with accent, «où», it is «where». They sound the same.

He loves it; I love it.

autrefois.consejo: It's used to start telling something about the past.

j'habitais.consejo: It comes from «habiter» (live). With «je» it is written with an apostrophe.

trad.en: You were talking. You were talking.
You were, you were; you were, you were.
I liked it, I wanted to (I)

joue.consejo: In present, the form of «I» is «je joue».

plu.consejo: It goes with «avoir»: il a plu.

beau.consejo: At «il fait beau», it means it's been a while.

arrivé.consejo: He goes with «être»: je suis arrivé, elle est arrivée.

fera.consejo: «Il fera beau»: It will make good weather.

s'il.consejo: It goes in front of a verb: s-l-l-l-l-l-l-l-l-l.

mal.consejo: It goes with «avoir mal»: have pain.

aux.consejo: It is used in front of a plural: aux piens, aux yeux.

faut.consejo: It comes from «il faut», which expresses obligation.

trad.en: and to them, and to them,

y.consejo: It replaces a place already named.

ta.consejo: It is used in front of a feminine name: ta sœur.

trad.es: tu (posesivo, con cosa o persona femenina)
trad.en: you (possessive, with something or person feminine)

en (pronombre).consejo: It is not «en» (place): it replaces «de» + thing.

bonne.consejo: It goes with feminine noun: une bonne idée.

patron.consejo: For a man or a woman: the boss, the boss.

trad.es: compañero de trabajo, compañera de trabajo

interdit.consejo: «Il est interdit de fumer» = no smoking.

resté.consejo: He goes with «être»: je suis resté.

parti.consejo: With «être» the participle matches the subject.
